cost_scope: Illustrative normalised decision-unit costs, not NZD or laboratory quotations. Same decision scale as M2; no field-funding claim.
time_scope: Five equally weighted subperiods of the existing consequence horizon; no lifetime extension or double population scaling.
interpretation: Model-probability grid is a conditional sensitivity curve without a selected distribution; robust envelopes do not average scenarios or assign probabilities to viewpoints.
status: Conditional finite-method demonstration; preserves M2 source/estimand limits. No new empirical data assimilated.
implementation_scope: Unimplemented portions realise the declared reference policy. Uptake profiles are analyst scenarios, not fitted Innovate outputs.
